expected.notes: Born to Lord 1 Deer and Lady 1 Deer at the Apoala sacred-tree emergence. The most narratively-elaborated of the second-generation Mixtec pantheon.

Descended from the celestial realm to the Mixteca-Alta on a knotted cord-of-heaven; established cult-centers, instructed humanity in agriculture, ritual, and codex-painting; identified iconographically with the Aztec/Mexica wind-deity Quetzalcoatl-Ehécatl through the buccal mask and conch jewelry.
Performed the cosmogonic action of lifting the sky and separating the celestial waters from the terrestrial waters, establishing the framework within which the Mixtec dynastic-history could begin.

expected.notes: Co-creator of the Mixtec pantheon-tier; emerged with Lady 1 Deer from the cleft sacred tree at Yuta Tnoho ("River of Lineages") at Apoala in the Mixteca-Alta. The Apoala emergence is the foundational Mixtec cosmogonic event.

With Lady 1 Deer, engendered the second-generation Mixtec pantheon-tier figures (Lord 9 Wind, Lord 7 Flower, etc.) who in turn engendered the founder-dynasties of the Mixteca-Alta polities (Tilantongo, Teozacualco, Apoala, Tlaxiaco, Achiutla, Tutu Tepec, etc.).
